title: Mieterverein Berlin - Quick Summary
items: **Three big tenant associations** cover most of Berlin: the **Berliner Mieterverein** (€132 a year, cover included), the **Berliner MieterGemeinschaft** (€75 with cover) and the **Mieterschutzbund Berlin** (€54 plus €49.20 for cover).
**Legal cover has a waiting period.** Berliner Mieterverein: **3 months** from the 1st of the joining month. MieterGemeinschaft: **1 month** after your fee arrives. Mieterschutzbund: **6 weeks**.
**The letter that made you join is not covered.** A problem that already existed when you signed up is excluded, so the cheapest moment to join is before anything goes wrong.
**The letters run on legal dates.** A 2025 service-charge bill must reach you by **31 December 2026**, and a rent increase gives you until the **end of the second full month** to answer.
**Free advice exists in every district**, but it cannot write to your landlord or pay for a court case.
**My move:** join in September and a Berliner Mieterverein membership covers you from 1 December, just as the service-charge bills arrive.
